topics.title: Geometric Progression (GP) & GM
concepts: Sum of infinite GP S_∞ = a/(1 - r) for |r| < 1
Inequality of AM and GM: AM ≥ GM

formulas: AP nth term: a_n = a + (n - 1)d
GP nth term: a_n = a r^(n-1)
GP Sum: S_n = a(1 - r^n) / (1 - r)
Infinite GP Sum: S_∞ = a / (1 - r)  (when |r| < 1)
AM = (a + b) / 2, GM = √(ab), AM ≥ GM

maths.name: Straight Lines
maths.description: Slope of line, various forms of line equations, angle between lines, perpendicular distance, and distance between parallel lines.

topics.title: Slope & Various Forms of Line Equations
concepts: Slope m = tan θ = (y2 - y1)/(x2 - x1)
Point-slope form: y - y1 = m(x - x1)
Normal form: x cos ω + y sin ω = p

topics.title: Angle Between Lines & Distance Formulas
concepts: Perpendicular distance of (x1, y1) from Ax + By + C = 0: d = |Ax1 + By1 + C| / √(A^2 + B^2)
Distance between parallel lines: d = |C1 - C2| / √(A^2 + B^2)

formulas: Slope m = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1) = tan θ
Slope-Intercept: y = m x + c
Point-Slope: y - y1 = m (x - x1)
Intercept Form: x/a + y/b = 1
Angle between lines: tan θ = |(m2 - m1) / (1 + m1 m2)|
Perpendicular Distance: d = |A x1 + B y1 + C| / √(A^2 + B^2)
Distance between Parallel Lines: d = |C1 - C2| / √(A^2 + B^2)

maths.name: Conic Sections
maths.description: Circles, Parabola, Ellipse, Hyperbola standard equations, eccentricity, foci, directrix, vertices, and latus rectum.

topics.title: Circle
concepts: General equation x^2 + y^2 + 2gx + 2fy + c = 0, centre (-g, -f), radius √(g^2 + f^2 - c)

topics.title: Parabola
concepts: Standard forms: y^2 = 4ax, y^2 = -4ax, x^2 = 4ay, x^2 = -4ay
Focus (a, 0), Directrix x = -a, Latus rectum length = 4a, Eccentricity e = 1

topics.title: Ellipse
concepts: Major axis 2a, Minor axis 2b, Latus rectum = 2b^2/a

topics.title: Hyperbola
concepts: Transverse axis 2a, Conjugate axis 2b, Latus rectum = 2b^2/a

formulas: Circle: (x - h)^2 + (y - k)^2 = r^2
Parabola (y^2 = 4ax): Focus (a, 0), Directrix x = -a, Latus Rectum = 4a
Hyperbola (x^2/a^2 - y^2/b^2 = 1): e = √(1 + b^2/a^2), Foci (±ae, 0), LR = 2b^2/a

maths.name: Introduction to 3D Geometry
maths.description: Coordinate axes & planes in 3D, octants, distance formula, section formula in 3D space.

topics.title: Distance & Section Formula in 3D
concepts: Internal division: ((m x2 + n x1)/(m+n), (m y2 + n y1)/(m+n), (m z2 + n z1)/(m+n))

formulas: Section Formula: P = ( (mx2 + nx1)/(m+n), (my2 + ny1)/(m+n), (mz2 + nz1)/(m+n) )
Centroid of Triangle: G = ( (x1+x2+x3)/3, (y1+y2+y3)/3, (z1+z2+z3)/3 )

maths.name: Limits and Derivatives
maths.description: Intuitive idea of limit, standard limits (algebraic, trigonometric), derivative as rate of change, first principle, product & quotient rules.

topics.title: Limits & Standard Algebraic/Trig Limits
concepts: Left hand limit (LHL) and Right hand limit (RHL)
lim(x→0) (1 - cos x)/x = 0, lim(x→0) (1 - cos x)/x^2 = 1/2

topics.title: Derivative by First Principle & Standard Derivatives
concepts: d/dx(sin x) = cos x, d/dx(cos x) = -sin x, d/dx(tan x) = sec^2 x
d/dx(sec x) = sec x tan x, d/dx(cosec x) = -cosec x cot x, d/dx(cot x) = -cosec^2 x

topics.title: Algebra of Derivatives (Product & Quotient Rules)
concepts: Product rule: (u v)' = u' v + u v'
Quotient rule: (u / v)' = (u' v - u v') / v^2

formulas: lim(x→a) (x^n - a^n) / (x - a) = n a^(n-1)
lim(x→0) (sin x) / x = 1, lim(x→0) (tan x) / x = 1
First Principle: f'(x) = lim(h→0) [f(x+h) - f(x)] / h
Product Rule: d/dx (u · v) = u' v + u v'
Quotient Rule: d/dx (u / v) = (u' v - u v') / v^2
d/dx (x^n) = n x^(n-1)

maths.name: Statistics and Probability
maths.description: Measures of dispersion (mean deviation, variance, standard deviation), axiomatic probability, addition rule, mutually exclusive & exhaustive events.

topics.title: Measures of Dispersion (Variance & SD)
concepts: Mean deviation about mean and median
Variance σ^2 = Σ(x_i - x̄)^2 / n = Σ x_i^2 / n - (x̄)^2

topics.title: Axiomatic Probability & Event Algebra
concepts: Sample space, events (sure, impossible, mutually exclusive, exhaustive)
P(A ∪ B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A ∩ B)
For mutually exclusive events: P(A ∩ B) = 0 ⟹ P(A ∪ B) = P(A) + P(B)

formulas: Mean Deviation about Mean: MD(x̄) = Σ |x_i - x̄| / N
Variance σ^2 = (1/N) Σ (x_i - x̄)^2 = (1/N) Σ x_i^2 - (x̄)^2
Standard Deviation σ = √(Variance)
Coefficient of Variation: CV = (σ / x̄) × 100
P(A ∪ B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A ∩ B)
P(not A) = 1 - P(A)
